subject: TOURN: only 6 teams exist (hardcoded) - maxTeams is dead config, real cap 24 users
description: Teams come from a hardcoded 6-item literal at _app/admin/console.html:11118. No add-team UI, no Cloud Function, and the only teams write is inside that loop. maxTeams is settable 2-200 in the console and is read by NOTHING at creation. Real ceiling = 6 x maxTeamSize = 24 default, 60 absolute (maxTeamSize caps at 10). Worse, console.html:11040 renders teamCount/maxTeams so an admin sees '6/32', implying headroom that cannot be reached. Fix: generate teams from maxTeams at creation, or add a create-team path, or stop displaying an unreachable ceiling. Found 2026-08-29 tournament QC.
